title: Finding
description: A single review finding. Per the soft-pipeline triage rules: scope determines blocking behaviour; severity downgrades automatically when test_to_catch is judgement-only.

id.description: Unique within the review.json file. Sequential.

scope.description: in_ticket: file is in plan.files_to_change. adjacent: file is imported by or imports something in_ticket. unrelated: anywhere else. Routing: in_ticket → must apply/argue/defer. adjacent → file as P2 follow-up, never blocks. unrelated → file as P3 follow-up, never blocks.

severity.description: blocker/major: in_ticket scope must address. minor/nit: log only. Auto-downgrade one tier if test_to_catch.verifiability == 'judgement_only'.

name.description: Rule name (e.g. 'rule_38_app_check'), contract identifier (e.g. 'FirebaseFunctionsException must have code'), or empirical assertion (e.g. 'when input is whitespace, output should match regex').

evidence.description: Concrete failure mode. Specific input → wrong output, or specific code path → broken invariant. Vague evidence ('this seems wrong') is not evidence.

verifiability.description: tested: there's a concrete test that would fail. reviewable: deterministic static check (grep, schema, build) would catch. judgement_only: no automatic check — pure human judgement. Findings with judgement_only auto-downgrade severity one tier.

test_snippet.description: If verifiability == 'tested', a minimal failing-test code snippet that would catch this. Required to claim 'tested'.

static_check.description: If verifiability == 'reviewable', the exact static check (e.g. 'grep -q enforceAppCheck lib/league/joinLeagueByCode.js').

status.description: Set by the apply-feedback worker as it processes each finding. Initial: pending.

response.description: Set by apply-feedback worker if status != applied. Records what was done and why.

argued_reason.description: Why the worker rejected this finding. Required when status == argued.

deferred_to_ticket.description: Ticket ID created as follow-up. Required when status == deferred.
